findings.summary: Shared PeriodPicker reads the feature-specific agentPerformance i18n namespace
findings.failure_scenario: A screen that does not load agentPerformance messages renders missing-key strings in the picker
findings.fix: Accept labels via props or move period.* keys to a shared namespace

findings.rule: duplicated cross-package logic must move together
findings.summary: HOURLY_BUCKET_MAX_MS is duplicated from the server, linked only by a comment
findings.failure_scenario: Server changes the hourly cutoff; the client sparkline unit label disagrees with the series
findings.fix: Keep one client constant and note the server pairing in INSIGHTS.md

findings.summary: Redundant (dataFrom as Date) cast hides a narrowing issue in skillsUsage/memoryUsage
findings.fix: Type the tracker explicitly instead of casting

findings.summary: Skill names from trace skills_used are returned without a length or count cap, unlike memory labels.
findings.failure_scenario: Oversized skills_used array in a stored trace -> inflated /agents/:id/stats response.
findings.fix: Slice names to a max length and cap items, or add .max() in SkillUsageItem.
